card.name: Word before a following noun in medical phrases
card.fires_on: Partway through or at the end of a medical term whose next word is a predictable noun, such as microtubule inhibitor, skin test, glomerular filtration, or influenza vaccines.

modes.label: Inside long medical words
modes.description: Partway through a long technical word that is about to be completed or followed by a set noun.

modes.label: Body site or test word
modes.description: A body part or test word like skin, arm or neck that sits before a procedure or action noun.
